en.title: Maximum Historical Income
en.description:
The price on day i is A[i]. You initially hold 1 unit of the asset and can hold at most 1 unit at any time; you may sell on any day and buy when you are not holding. Find the maximum total profit and output it modulo 10^9.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n prices. 1≤n≤200000, 0≤A[i]≤10^9.
en.output: Output the maximum total profit mod 1000000000.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
